document.adaptation: The Spanish original dropped; lead-in and English translation rewritten as an inline quote; the quoted “abuelitos” put in single quotes inside the quote.
document.text: Vicente spoke with Global Voices about the impact of the Good Neighbor Program on a country like Venezuela: “We can't put an end to poverty, but we can do our bit to help those who need it most, which in this country, is a lot. For now, we are focusing on a small group: the most disadvantaged ‘abuelitos’.”
